content:
On this episode of Overtime, we answer your comments on the touchscreen MacBook Pro and the iPad mini’s missing 120Hz display, then dive into the iOS 27.3 beta. Safari adopts adaptive dark mode and vertical tabs, StandBy is redesigned, and the new Health app returns. We also debate Apple Watch’s controversial Siri Recap and Live Rewind features. Is your watch always listening, and should you be worried?
